goal: Maintain a safe Windows desktop control surface for ChatGPT official-account and Relay request routing, explicit session management, encrypted recovery, Skills, and self-update.
primary_users: Windows users who operate ChatGPT/Codex locally and need auditable request-route switching and recovery
deliverables: A Tauri desktop application with a typed React and Rust command boundary
Official-login-preserving Account and Relay request-route switching
Explicit session synchronization, encrypted backup and restore, Skill management, and verified self-update
Executable tests, release gates, and synchronized long-term project documentation
non_goals: Replacing the ChatGPT official login flow
Sharing user credentials or publishing a hosted relay service
Silently rewriting existing conversation files or terminating unrelated standalone Codex CLI processes

facts: The desktop UI is React/TypeScript and the native backend is Rust/Tauri on Windows.
The live Codex root resolves from CODEX_HOME and otherwise defaults to the current user .codex directory.
Official auth.json is sensitive and request-route switching treats it as read-only authority.
Relay credentials are DPAPI encrypted at rest and projected only into the active managed config.toml provider.
Request-route switching reaches a durable config-only terminal before optional bounded indexed session closure; manual complete sync remains an explicit closed-state mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: The Tauri production artifact renders the dashboard and native window actions complete without a development server.
Account and Relay routing preserve official login state, apply only the managed request configuration, and fail closed before mutation on invalid prerequisites.
Session, backup, restore, and update mutations remain bounded, encrypted where required, compensating, and independently testable.
Frontend and Rust tests, type checks, lint, production builds, release contracts, encoding checks, and secret checks are explicit and reproducible.
Architecture, file ownership, development workflow, Git boundaries, and observable behavior stay synchronized in the governed project documents.

assumptions: The maintained target is Windows and current-user DPAPI is available.
ChatGPT owns official login refreshes; this application does not mint or replace official credentials.
Git stage, commit, push, PR, tag, and release remain explicit user-authorized actions.
